text: [{"id":"VIRTUA-1.3-1","section":"1.3","section_title":"","text":"Hospital Staff will identify the information acquired from Patients, Chemists and Labs.","kind":"functional","testable":true,"refs":[]},{"id":"VIRTUA-1.3-2","section":"1.3","section_title":"","text":"Hospital Staff will state the requirements of the software.","kind":"functional","testable":true,"refs":[]},{"id":"VIRTUA-1.3-3","section":"1.3","section_title":"","text":"Their feedback will also be needed to modify the existing requirements.","kind":"functional","testable":true,"refs":[]},{"id":"VIRTUA-1.3-4","section":"1.3","section_title":"","text":"This document shall also serve as the reference document for Project Management and Development team (Mishal and Samyak).","kind":"functional","testable":true,"refs":[]},{"id":"VIRTUA-1.3-5","section":"1.3","section_title":"","text":"Project Management and Development team will Analyze, Design and Implement the System.","kind":"functional","testable":true,"refs":[]},{"id":"VIRTUA-1.3-6","section":"1.3","section_title":"","text":"They will coordinate every activity that take place in the Software Engineering process.","kind":"functional","testable":true,"refs":[]},{"id":"VIRTUA-1.3-7","section":"1.3","section_title":"","text":"They will be guided by Prof. Chandrasekaran and other esteemed staff of NITK Computer Science & Engineering Department under development.","kind":"functional","testable":true,"refs":[]},{"id":"VIRTUA-1.4-1","section":"1.4","section_title":"Product Scope","text":"The Hospital has decided to provide quality medicines via authorized Chemists located within the zone at discounted prices.","kind":"functional","testable":true,"refs":[]},{"id":"VIRTUA-1.4-2","section":"1.4","section_title":"Product Scope","text":"The Hospital has decided to provide door-step Laboratory services wherever possible via specimen collection.","kind":"functional","testable":true,"refs":[]}]
